summary: New idiom: aloho ksohəḏ 'Gott ist Zeuge; bei Gott (Bekräftigung)'

data.headword: aloho ksohəḏ 'Gott ist Zeuge; bei Gott (Bekräftigung)'
data.turoyo: Eee, aloho ksohəḏ, hul l uʕdo... Yaʕni xlaf lə kumarnolox, Ǧan, hway amin.
data.translation: Yes, God bears witness, even now... I mean I am not telling you a lie, Jan; be assured.

rationale: Repeated formula at six Jan sources; denial of lying makes the assertion-confirming function explicit. Searches aloho ksoh and sohəḏ find no existing formula. Supplied project machine translation [MT].

summary: All 14 occurrences checked. I Preterit has ordinary l-series agents, including full l-marked plural witnesses. ʕal- can identify either an adverse person or a neutral attested topic; s- adds an audience at PrS 67/86. Content is a demonstrative, d-clause or direct report.
